_doc: Per-project config for the luismc-delivery plugin, written to .delivery/config.json by claude-setup (never overwritten once present). Keys starting with _ are ignored. A `brief_markers` entry that is a list is satisfied by any one string in it. `runners[]` lists the CI runners the project uses: `name` (as GitHub shows it) and `repair` (commands run in order when the runner is offline: a string runs through the shell, a list is an argv; D6a). `runner_plan.report_command` is the project's report channel (gets the text in $DELIVERY_REPORT). Validate with delivery_config.py validate (unknown keys warn). enforcement, watcher and runner_plan flags are described in DELIVERYSPEC section 6. Neutral defaults; _example_windows_monorepo shows values for a Windows monorepo.

runners.name: win-runner-1
repair: sc stop actions.runner.org-repo.win-runner-1 & sc start actions.runner.org-repo.win-runner-1
